noise_robustness.paired_design_note: Zero-noise points are reused from the seed sweep.

strongest_defensible_conclusion: Synthetic robustness was evaluated under a paired one-factor-at-a-time design with 23 completed runs and 0 failed runs. Strict symbolic structure recovery succeeded in 13 of 23 eligible completed runs; joint linear/quadratic coefficient recovery succeeded in 21 of 23 eligible completed runs. These controlled synthetic results support only the tested simulation regime and do not establish clinical validity or higher-order factor interactions.
